en-US.name: Joe's Collection
en-US.summary: Ask what Joe needs, what a package code contains, or which codes contain a figure.
en-US.description: Use a four-word sharing code to connect Joe's collection tracker, then ask how many figures he still needs, what a package code contains, or which package codes contain a named figure. Package colors distinguish each series.
examplePhrases: Alexa, ask Joe's collection how many red Death Star guys does Joe need
Alexa, ask Joe's collection what's in gray Death Star code I eight
Alexa, ask Joe's collection what code is Queen Amidala in the red Death Star

publishingInformation.testingInstructions: This skill has no account linking. Pair the dedicated empty certification collection by saying: "Alexa, ask Joe's collection to use sharing code foxglove lizard donut donut." Then test: (1) "Alexa, ask Joe's collection how many red Death Star guys does Joe need." Expected: Joe needs 25 of 25. (2) "Alexa, ask Joe's collection what's in gray Death Star code I eight." Expected: four figure names and that Joe needs all four. (3) "Alexa, ask Joe's collection what code is Queen Amidala in the red Death Star." Expected: all twelve recorded package codes. The certification code contains no family data and may be reset after review. This is an independent personal collection utility. Third-party product and character names are used only to identify lawfully purchased figures and their packaging; the skill uses no third-party logos, artwork, audio, or images and does not claim affiliation or endorsement.
